name: Singita Sabora Tented Camp
insider_take: This ultra-luxe tented camp sits in the heart of the Serengeti's Great Migration corridor, where over two million wildebeest thunder past your canvas doorstep twice a year.
whats_special: Singita Sabora's nine pavilion-style tents feature antique furnishings and Persian rugs that recreate the romance of 1920s explorer camps. The camp relocates seasonally to follow the Great Migration, offering front-row seats to one of nature's greatest spectacles. Each tent includes a private sala (outdoor living area) and the camp's elevated position provides panoramic views across the endless Serengeti plains.
pro_tip: Book during the calving season (January-March) when the camp is positioned near Ndutu for incredible predator action as newborn wildebeest attract lions and cheetahs.
dont_miss: The camp's exclusive Serengeti traverse spans 350,000 acres of pristine wilderness. Take a hot air balloon safari at dawn to witness the Great Migration from above, followed by a champagne breakfast in the bush. The mobile spa offers treatments under ancient acacia trees with nothing but wildlife sounds as your soundtrack.
pros: Prime Serengeti location for exceptional wildlife viewing and Great Migration access
Luxurious canvas pavilions with modern amenities and authentic safari atmosphere
World-class guided game drives and expert naturalist guides
Award-winning cuisine and premium all-inclusive dining experience
cons: Remote wilderness location requires charter flights
